chunks: And by this chain, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Isma'il ibn Mansur, from Mansur ibn Yunus Buzurg, who said:
I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: Washing the head with Khatmi (marshmallow plant) brings sustenance (rizq) significantly.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of washing the head with Khatmi according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-A'mal, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS) linking the physical act of washing the head with the Khatmi plant to the spiritual and material blessing of rizq. This narration reflects the Shia tradition of 'tadarruj' (gradualism), where specific natural remedies are viewed not merely as medicinal but as means of divine grace that facilitate sustenance. It underscores the holistic view of well-being in Shia jurisprudence, where physical care and spiritual intentionality work in tandem to attract Allah's provision.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3.  Imam  Musa  Kadhim  (a.s.)  says,  “Washing  head  with Khatmi is the best way to increase one’s earnings.”
